title: NumPy Tutorial: Your First Steps Into Data Science in Python
description: Follow this NumPy tutorial to learn how to create and manipulate arrays in Python and take your first steps into data science.
summary: NumPy is a Python library that provides a simple yet powerful data structure : the n-dimensional array . This is the foundation on which almost all the power of Python’s data science toolkit is built, and learning NumPy is the first step on any Python data scientist’s journey.
takeaways: This is the foundation on which almost all the power of Python’s data science toolkit is built, and learning NumPy is the first step on any Python data scientist’s journey.

Installing NumPy With Anaconda The Anaconda distribution is a suite of common Python data science tools bundled around a package manager that helps manage your virtual environments and project dependencies.
